comment: He knows a lot about GIS, but the lectures and the homework were boring (just following instructions using the software). The second part of the semester was more interesting because we got to work on our own projects and apply the concepts learned. His feedback is tough, as he doesn't compliment anything, just points out what needs to be improved.

Dr. Huang is definitely knowledgeable in GIS, but has some trouble relaying that knowledge to his students. The midterm, even after studying and having notes prepared, was nothing like I expected. A lot of good students did not do well and it caused a reduction in letter grades. If youre a good student, youll do ok but it will be a challenge.

Dr. Huang is clearly a knowledgeable person. However, very little of his knowledge translates to his teaching. When asking for help I was often told that sucks and never truly got guidance. The midterm was on things that we had never discussed and the final project was very unclear. Avoid taking a class with this professor if you can help it.
